description: This source file defines a utility class 'EventConstants' that contains constant string values and a utility method related to event handling within the Eclipse Hono project. It centralizes constant definitions for event endpoints and content types, and provides a method to check for empty notification types.

classes.name: EventConstants
classes.description: A final utility class that contains constants and static methods used throughout the Event API.

methods.name: isEmptyNotificationType
methods.description: Checks if the provided content type string matches the predefined empty notification content type.
